snippet.description:
A religion scholar is getting increasingly worried about the odds of a white Christian nationalist takeover in the US. While panicked allusions to Nazi Germany have been a common occurrence in the Trump years, Robert P. Jones believes those references are warranted now. 

Vox’s Christian Paz breaks down why this is: https://www.vox.com/politics/501931/christian-nationalism-nationalist-white-authoritarian-backslide-robert-jones-prri-christianity
